reason: LazyMemoizeSubject.getState() rebuilds a fresh-but-shallow-equal state object after every core notify. The tap useSyncExternalStore Object.is snapshot check then never passes, its forceUpdate (a c => c+1 reducer, always a new state) re-renders, and the loop runs to 'Maximum update depth exceeded' — the desktop chat-pane crash of 2026-08-24 (verified live: 'changed fields: none, fresh identity only'). Keeping the previous identity when a rebuild is shallow-equal is the same guard ShallowMemoizeSubject in the same file already uses. Upstream report pending; re-derive against upstream once fixed.
